arguments.name: centerPrice
docs: Initial center price: a normalized ratio scaled by PRICE_PRECISION (10^15)

arguments.name: revenueCut
docs: Revenue cut in 4 decimals (e.g., 100000 = 10%). Divided by 10000 for storage.

arguments.name: upperShiftThreshold
docs: Upper shift threshold percent in 4 decimals. Divided by 1000 for storage.

arguments.name: lowerShiftThreshold
docs: Lower shift threshold percent in 4 decimals. Divided by 1000 for storage.

arguments.name: thresholdShiftTime
docs: Time (seconds) for threshold-based center price shift

instructions.name: previewDexShares
docs: Read-only: returns the exact collateral/debt share deltas a real operate
would produce for the given (signed) token amounts, via `return_data`.
Mutates nothing; meant to be run through `simulateTransaction` so an SDK
can attach the correct vault tick / branch accounts. See `preview.rs`.
